Decision: Shawn asked whether to build a new .pmcro/ in the marketplace repo, and whether anything from canonical (W:\PMCR-O\.pmcro) should move here. Decision: keep this repo's .pmcro repo-local only (memory/MEMORY.md, trails/). Do NOT fork laws/colony-laws.md, constraints/earned-constraints.json, or agents/ AGENT.md files here -- those stay single-sourced in canonical. Added identity.json (repo-local, points at canonical governance paths instead of duplicating values) and laws/POINTER.md (explicit no-fork notice + where to look instead).
Rationale: The exact failure this session already surfaced once: an earlier MEMORY.md in this repo asserted 'no .pmcro existed anywhere' without checking canonical, because the two stores had no cross-reference. Copying governance files here would recreate that failure mode the moment either copy is edited independently.
OpenFollowUp: If Shawn later wants true single-repo consolidation (marketplace repo's trails living inside canonical .pmcro instead of alongside it), that is a bigger move (physically relocating trail history) and should be its own explicit decision, not inferred from this one.
